title: My experience
description: Choose an organization-permitted experience and adjust your record sections.
offline: Reconnect to read the current policy and preferences.
personalOnly: These choices affect only your account. They do not change the organization default or install code.
retained: Some saved choices are unavailable or blocked. They remain stored and are ignored where incompatible.
ignored: Not applied under the current policy or record surface.
selectionBlocked: Personal selection is blocked or no catalog is configured. You may still reset a saved choice.
noProfile: No usable profile is selected. The application baseline applies.
otherOwners: Language, home and navigation remain in Navigation and language. Views and dashboard widgets keep their existing editors and settings when you switch experience.
contextHint: Ordering and omission affect only the configured main sections. Record permissions and visibility still apply; an available reference is not proof of a working journey.
stale: The profile, policy or saved adjustment changed while you were editing. Discard this local draft to load current values before saving.
noComposition: This presentation uses its own composition and has no configurable main region.
orderBlocked: Personal section ordering is blocked by the organization.
ownerBlocked: Its owner has not declared this source personally optional, or the owner is inactive.
hideBlocked: Omission is blocked by organization policy.
discard: Discard local changes and use current saved values
resetHint: This reset clears only your saved record-detail composition, including another record surface retained from a previous profile. It does not reset profile selection, navigation, views, dashboard, language or shared configuration.
